title: Try this shirt
objectives: try on clothing and ask about sizes

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Try this shirt.
Welcome to today's lesson: Try this shirt! Today we will practice how to use demonstratives (this, that, these, those).

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for Try this shirt:
use demonstratives (this, that, these, those); try on clothing and ask about sizes

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: shirt, shoes, pants, size, small, large

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: Which demonstrative points to singular items near you?

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: Can I try on this shirt in size medium? Those shoes look comfortable.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
Try this shirt! It is size small. Those shoes are very nice. I like this blue shirt.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Roleplay trying on clothes in a store and asking for different sizes.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: use demonstratives (this, that, these, those), try on clothing and ask about sizes.
